function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning some patients appear more than once in the dataset.", "implication": "This means the raw row count (848) overcounts patients. To compute the number of unique patients, we must deduplicate by `patient_id`, keeping only one row per patient. The instruction in the data dictionary confirms this: 'The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.' So we must group by `patient_id` and take the max `sample_seq` for each."}
function.name: note_finding
